facts.fact: SPIN (Gabon) and CAMTEL (Cameroon) have signed a memorandum of understanding and a confidentiality agreement on CAB-CORRIDOR, a terrestrial interconnection between Cameroon, Gabon and the Republic of Congo over the Central African Backbone, with implementation modalities expected in October 2026; signing dates are not stated, so the document's published date is used.

systems.platform: terrestrial interconnection over the Central African Backbone (CAB)
